mapper.select: SELECT REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, #{searchDate} as hodeDate, MDATE as busiMDate, BALANCE_AMT as prdBalanceAmt, PRD_QTY as prdTotalQty, TOTAL_AMT as prdRaiseTotalQty, RAISE_QTY prdRaiseTotalAmt, SUM(CNY_AMT) as inverstTolAmt, SUM(QTY) as inverstTolQTY FROM (SELECT REG_CODE, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY, CNY_AMT, QTY, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by tmp1.REG_CODE, tmp1.MDATE, C.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY C.STATUS DESC ) AS hodeStsNo FROM( SELECT REG_CODE, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY FROM( SELECT A.REG_CODE, A.MDATE, A.BALANCE_AMT, A.PRD_QTY, B.TOTAL_AMT, B.RAISE_QTY, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by A.REG_CODE , A.MDATE ORDER BY B.STATUS DESC ) AS raiseStatusNo FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB B ON (A.REG_CODE = B.PROD_REGIST_CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02') ) ) WHERE raiseStatusNo = 1 ) tmp1 LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB C ON (tmp1.REG_CODE = C.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND C.STATUS IN ('01','02') ) WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(C.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) WHERE hodeStsNo = 1 GROUP BY REG_CODE, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY
